Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: high-definition transparent 2D fighting-game animation sprites for PhiloKombat.
Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: exactly four existing Averroes animation poses in a 2x2 grid. Input 2 is Averroes' facial identity and detailed costume reference. Input 3 (Felipe) is ONLY the desired rendering fidelity/material-detail reference; never copy his identity, clothes, tattoos or pose.
Restore the FOUR poses with substantially sharper authentic detail, at the same realistic arcade illustration quality and dimensional finish as Felipe: distinct natural eyes and facial planes, individual dark beard hairs, neatly wrapped deep-teal turban fabric, ivory linen weave and folds, deep-green outer robe with fine gold embroidered edging, sash and brown leather shoes, crisp leather manuscript and page edges only in frames that already show it. Mature olive-skinned Andalusian/North African scholar, consistent facial identity with input 2 across all four poses. Natural detailed skin and cloth, precise realistic hands. This is a high-definition restoration of source detail, not an enlarged blurry sprite or pixel art.
STRICT INVARIANTS: keep the exact corresponding original body pose, direction facing right, limb angles, fists, kicks, knees, palm gestures, stance, lean and props/effects in each target quadrant. Keep all four poses in the same order. Exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, two feet per person; never duplicate limbs or props. Do not turn a kick, seated defeat or spell into a standing guard pose. Preserve the green turban of the target. Preserve special halos and palm lights where already present. Do not add manuscripts to empty-handed fighting poses.
FRAMING: 2 columns x 2 rows, square high-resolution sheet ideally 2048x2048 or larger. All four COMPLETE figures, shoes, kicks, hands, headgear and effects entirely within their respective quadrants with generous transparent padding at least 8% on every edge, clearly separated transparent row/column gutters. Full head-to-toe figures, no cropping or crossing between quadrants.
BACKGROUND: genuine transparent alpha, no ground plane, no floor shadows, no colored matte, checkerboard texture, mosaic, pixels or white outlines. Remove stray isolated specks including the thin white fragment below the supporting shoe in kicking frames. No grid, labels, text or watermark.
